name: run-performance-surface
description: The paired surface/plain measurement of the gauntlet, Tools/gauntlet/harness/performance-surface.mjs, and its Jet twin, the PerformanceSurface module of the jet_gauntlet_kit package (Tools/gauntlet/kit/Source/PerformanceSurface.jet), #5072 c8, each run by a driver: measurements with stand-in builds and runs of the compound and list-fill pairs (wins, losses, ties, inconclusive bootstraps), builds that fail with and without stderr, missing compiler identity, a compiler artifact gone or changed, manifests held and stale, timed-out, signalled, wrong-output, contaminated and failed samples, each receipt shown by its status, verdict, preflight issues and SHA-256 and its validation; receipts changed to lack confidence, overlap, name stale sources, forge ratios, statistics and verdicts, drop samples, rows, context and the sampling contract, break arm identity and the schema; every performance-surface pair of the canonical measurement manifest with its evidence receipt (checked against the original, as the manifest moves with the gauntlet); and the command line's help, unknown arguments and unknown pairs. The twin identifies the compiler artifact by SHA-256 alone, so its receipts carry no artifact_md5, and the original driver leaves that field out of the receipt it hashes.
